scenes.title: Truth in the Courtyard
scenes.summary: Rami explains how he accidentally swapped suitcases with Suad on Monday's intercity bus and panicked at the gate.

scenes.title: Three Years of Silence
scenes.summary: At the front desk Tariq unlocks the blue suitcase for Rami, who explains the three-year silence with his brother Ziad.

scenes.title: Friday Lemon Cake
scenes.summary: Suad recalls what the brothers always ate after Friday piano lessons, giving Salma a bright baking idea.

scenes.title: Two Chairs Under the Tree
scenes.summary: Nour, Salma, and Tariq arrange a quiet corner table under the courtyard tree and check the string of lanterns.

scenes.title: Simple Words First
scenes.summary: At eleven forty Rami practices stiff speeches in the courtyard until Nour helps him choose three simple, honest lines.

scenes.title: Ten Minutes to Twelve
scenes.summary: At eleven fifty the postman drops off an official registered letter for Mazen, who sets it aside to greet noon.

scenes.title: Twelve Chimes
scenes.summary: Twelve o'clock strikes with an empty gate, Rami loses hope for a long minute, and then a taxi brakes outside.

scenes.title: The Red-Stamped Letter
scenes.summary: As Ziad steps into the courtyard outside, Mazen opens the landlord's letter inside and turns pale at a sale notice.
